status: paper expectations; not provider/CLI execution or adoption
grammarScope: The discovery examples retain staged inherited profile vocabulary only to exercise binding/extension structure; no final retained profile/Type/Event/advanced surface is selected by these examples.

scenarios.expected: An ordinary command selects an actually implemented contract from discovery; user Resource revision flags retain their separate meaning.
New-version request uses application/vnd.bdp.v0.1+json. Do not encode version only as an application/json parameter that an old endpoint can ignore.
An endpoint lacking the selected JSON request type refuses415 before payload interpretation/key claim/effects; client does not retry using generic JSON.
An otherwise valid read accepting no supported representation gets bodyless406; client does not treat it as a successful empty result.
CLI bdp_spec equals the actual selected specification/schema URI independently of CLI schema_version2, executable version or mutable capability list.
A base client can ignore an unknown capability/version entry; it does not interpret feature-owned details or lose supported base behavior.
Advertising a newer capability version alongside an older one preserves explicit selection of the older version; strings compare exactly, not by inferred order/range.
A required unsupported feature refuses before new mutation effects instead of narrowing predicates, dropping pins or splitting atomic batch.
Uncertain recovery preserves original contract/media/Scope/inputs/key; a changed contract is not permission to reexecute or replace the key.
Read/Event continuation cannot be silently reinterpreted under a different contract or representation. Non-JSON Event transport binding still needs actual #153 composition.
The existing v0 schema/runtime/fixtures remain at actual old identity and bytes; a new exported JSON artifact neither upgrades SDK parsing nor qualifies old evidence as v0.1.
